blocks.text: This is the English edition of the Spanish original. The book was written as a thread on X on 17 November 2026. The texts of each part follow the original faithfully. Grok's replies are his real replies on X, translated from the original Spanish, and are signed “Grok (translation of the original Spanish; real reply on X)”. The texts by Gemini and by Copilot are likewise translations of their real texts, signed with their real author; they are not signed as Grok. Eva is the voice of the book, published on Pedro Sánchez Gómez's account.
